notes:
Bitify 1.8.1

The server has a spare. Bitify now ships two servers and picks between them itself - it probes each at startup and every 90 seconds and uses the first that answers. The account, Messages, the streak and the vault move together, so a server going away no longer takes signing in with it. This also brings a device back online if it had been left pointed at a server that stopped answering.

The community, in the top bar. Home now shows how many people have used Bitify, beside the update arrow. It is the server's count: each installation once, each account once, counted where it cannot be faked, and drawn from the last known value so it never slows the screen.

Full APK per ABI, no delta patch for this pair.
